move: four quadrants fly in from the corners, lock into a square, round off, flip on Y, pull back out
how: A 200px square built from four 100px quadrant divs (two white, two orange) each with one rounded outer corner, inside a preserve-3d wrap with 1200px perspective, and a tracked uppercase name. 0-35%: the quadrants fly in from their corners (x +-260, y +-200, rotation +-90) with expo.out, staggered 0.06s. At 35% every quadrant's borderRadius rounds to 28px (0.4s). At 42% the square flips rotationY 0->180 with power3.inOut over 0.8s while at 48% the name fades up 16px (power3.out). Exit at 78%: the quadrants pull back to their corners fading (power3.in, 0.03s stagger) and the name lifts and fades.
adapt: Change the two colours (white and #ff7a1a), the quadrant corner radius and the name; the quadrants could carry logo fragments. Keep the 0.7s expo.out fly-in with 0.06s stagger and the 0.8s power3.inOut flip.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the .sq with four quadrants and the name inside el, setting perspective on el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with fly-in 0-0.35D, round at 0.35D, flip at 0.42D, exit at 0.78D. Scope '.q1-4', '.sq', '.name' to el; the from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
perspective is set on .stage; set it on el when porting
